headline: Grok's AI-made Odyssey film admits inaccuracy amid harsh reviews
summary: Months after Elon Musk said his Grok-generated version of The Odyssey would outdo Christopher Nolan's film and be historically accurate, Grok itself acknowledged it is not historically accurate, while reviewers panned the film harshly.
